title: Correct Moon mass
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) is M = 4π²(R+h)³/(GT²).

title: Correct surface gravity
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) is g = 4π²(R+h)³/(T²R²).

title: Newton's law application
description: Important: Applies Newton's law of gravitation as centripetal force: GMm/(R+h)² = mω²(R+h).

title: Angular velocity relation
description: Important: Correctly relates orbital period T to angular velocity ω = 2π/T.

title: Gravity formula derivation
description: Important: Derives surface gravity using g = GM/R², substituting the expression for M.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Checks or mentions that the final expressions have correct units for mass and acceleration.

title: Incorrect radius usage
description: Pitfall: Uses R instead of (R+h) for the orbital radius in the centripetal force equation.

title: Algebraic or sign error
description: Pitfall: Makes an algebraic mistake in solving for M or g, or introduces an incorrect sign.
